deliberation: The purpose is to reduce recurring handling while preserving accountable authority. Five additional terminal reviews are proportionate for policy that could remove human review from future task classes, but would be disproportionate for each routine execution.
discharged_obligations: Evaluated utility, constraints, tradeoffs, and reversal conditions.
findings: At least 70 percent handling-time reduction and positive maintenance-adjusted savings remain mandatory.
The Human Steward decision remains separate.
amendments: Review the fifteen-office gate after this proceeding rather than generalizing it automatically.
residual_uncertainty: Review burden has not yet been measured against recurring savings.
